caption: The video captures a straight single railroad line stretching from the bottom edge of the frame toward a central vanishing point on the horizon, laid on grey gravel ballast with weathered wooden ties. The viewpoint moves steadily forward along the track, the nearest ties and ballast sliding toward the bottom edge and out of frame while the perspective convergence point stays near the horizontal center. The setting is arid desert scrub, with low bushes scattered on both sides drifting downward out of frame as the camera advances. A row of wooden utility poles with crossarms lines the right-of-way, appearing to grow slightly and shift outward as the gap to them closes. Faint low mountains sit on the left horizon beneath a pale blue sky streaked with thin high clouds. No train, people, or animals appear. The horizon height remains roughly constant, indicating a level, straight-ahead glide rather than a tilt or turn, and the forward travel continues unbroken.
